 Al-Shamal host Al Hilal in the AFC Champions League Elite, with Simone Inzaghi's side travelling to face the Qatari outfit in what is a significant continental test for both clubs. 
 Al-Shamal arrive in poor domestic form, having lost their most recent Stars League outing 2-3 to Qatar SC. David Prats' side have managed just one win across their last five matches, drawing three and losing twice, which leaves them rooted in the lower reaches of the West group standings. 
 Al Hilal, by contrast, are in exceptional form. Inzaghi's squad have won all five of their last five matches across the Saudi Pro League and AFC Champions League Elite, including a 3-2 victory over Al Ittihad and a 2-1 win over Al-Gharafa in continental play. 
 The Saudi side arrive off the back of a dramatic Saudi Pro League result, having beaten Al Qadsiah 3-2 away from home. That win reinforced their standing as one of the most consistent sides in the region this season. 
 Al Hilal sit third in the AFC Champions League Elite West group standings, giving this fixture added weight as Inzaghi's men look to push further up the table.
